related.title: Python heapq：優先佇列與不穩定同分
related.titleEn: Python heapq: priority queues and tie handling
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付sort-trace.csv、穩定性與排列斷言；不依賴某版本TimSort固定比較次數。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver sort-trace.csv, stability and permutation assertions without relying on a fixed comparison count. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 每次push/pop後列array及parent/child索引，逐邊驗證heap不變量。
related.differenceEn: Log the array and parent/child indices after each push/pop, checking the heap invariant on each edge.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
穩定排序保留相同key的原始相對次序；自然run可被利用，但實際比較次數取決於資料與實作細節。
本課數值核對：1+1+1 = 3 equal_key_items；另一項核對：6*5/2 = 15 pair_upper_bound。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

min-heap只保證root最小及父不大於子，不代表底層array全排序；同priority可加序號確保明確tie policy。
本課數值核對：1+1+3+5 = 10 priority_sum；另一項核對：floor(log2(4)) = 2 tree_height。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Stable sorting preserves input order among equal keys; natural runs can be exploited, but comparison counts depend on data and implementation.
Numeric audit: 1+1+1 = 3 equal_key_items; second audit: 6*5/2 = 15 pair_upper_bound. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A min-heap guarantees a minimum root and parent≤child, not a sorted backing array; add sequence numbers for a defined tie policy.
Numeric audit: 1+1+3+5 = 10 priority_sum; second audit: floor(log2(4)) = 2 tree_height. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Unicode UTF-8：碼點、位元組與分段解碼
related.titleEn: Unicode UTF-8: code points, bytes and incremental decoding

related.difference: 列每碼點U+值、UTF-8 hex與byte span；用增量decoder保留不完整序列，不逐chunk強制decode。
related.differenceEn: Record each U+ value, UTF-8 hex and span; use an incremental decoder to retain partial sequences instead of decoding chunks independently.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

本課數值核對：1+1+1 = 3 equal_key_items；另一項核對：6*5/2 = 15 pair_upper_bound。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

UTF-8使用1到4 bytes編碼Unicode scalar value；碼點數、byte數與使用者看到的字素數不相等。
本課數值核對：1+3+4 = 8 B；另一項核對：1+1+1 = 3 code_points。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Stable sorting preserves input order among equal keys; natural runs can be exploited, but comparison counts depend on data and implementation.
Numeric audit: 1+1+1 = 3 equal_key_items; second audit: 6*5/2 = 15 pair_upper_bound. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

UTF-8 uses one to four bytes per Unicode scalar value; code-point, byte and user-perceived grapheme counts differ.
Numeric audit: 1+3+4 = 8 B; second audit: 1+1+1 = 3 code_points. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
